open_source_rechecks.method: Ten full-address queries, spaced at least 1.1 seconds; accepted results only where returned postcode and house number matched the source address, with venue-name corroboration where mapped. Mapbox not used.
open_source_rechecks.result: 2 exact building/venue-point matches; 8 queries yielded no safe match; 90 records in the sample not externally queried.
